subject: Leadership reporting redesign — proposal, HR questions, and comms draft
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, People Ops <peopleops@example-hr.com>, Legal <legal@vendorco.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Leadership reporting redesign — proposal, HR questions, and comms draft

Team —

Attached is a compact proposal for a modest leadership reporting redesign I promised at the offsite. Goals: reduce manager spans in infra/runtime by creating two focused pods, clarify senior IC leadership lanes, and formalize a single point of contact for Dedicated partnerships. High-level bullets are in the PDF; the role-matrix has proposed scope changes and suggested grade/level adjustments.

Immediate asks:
- HR: can you review compensation/grade implications for the proposed lateral moves?
- Legal: any flagged contract or title phrasing we should avoid in comms?
- Leadership: feedback by EOD Thu (Feb 12) so we can sync with People Ops and publish the comms the following week.

Key constraints we discussed: avoid headcount increases, minimize disruption around active launches (especially runtime v2), and preserve defined manager-to-IC leveling paths.

I included a short comms draft in the Drive — it’s intentionally conservative. If we can agree to the structure (two pods under Marcus / Lauren, with a floating cross-cutting reliability lead), I’ll run a manager-readout + 1:1s schedule.

Attachments: org-chart-v2.pdf, role-matrix-v1.3.xlsx, comms-draft-ops.md

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
VP, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, People Ops <peopleops@example-hr.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:06:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Leadership reporting redesign — proposal, HR questions, and comms draft

Aditya — thanks for the clear summary and the docs. Quick read-through notes:

- I support smaller spans in runtime/infra; frees managers to coach instead of firefighting.
- On the role-matrix: request a one-line summary in the "Change Impact" column for each role (customer-facing, infra, runtime). Helps CS/SE handoffs.
- For the "floating reliability lead": can that be an L6 senior IC rather than a manager? Keeps upward mobility clear.

HR question: if we shift two senior ICs into new pod leads without title changes, will People Ops need to treat this as a promotion for equity adjustments? (cc'ing People Ops above)

Comms: I’d like the initial announcement to highlight rationale and timing (not just org chart). Draft look good — add a short FAQ about 1:1s and impacts to ongoing projects.

If no objections, I can consolidate feedback and run a brief readout with managers on Thu.

— Lauren
Director, Product Infra
From: People Ops <peopleops@example-hr.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 08:44:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Leadership reporting redesign — proposal, HR questions, and comms draft

Hi team —

Thanks for looping People Ops in. A few initial notes:

- If duties materially increase (more direct reports or expanded scope), compensation review is required; please flag which roles will have increased direct reports.
- For lateral title changes with additional remit, we will treat these as "scope change" reviews — typically a 2-3 week process for calibration and equity benchmarking.
- If you want quick temporary acknowledgements ("acting lead"), we can support short-term stipends; will need approvals from Finance for anything beyond 30 days.

Please attach a simple table mapping current hairline level (level/title) -> proposed scope -> whether comp review requested (Y/N). We can turn around the first pass next Tuesday (Feb 17) if we get the table today.

Best,
Maya Alvarez
People Ops Business Partner (Contracted)
PeopleOps Talent Services
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, People Ops <peopleops@example-hr.com>, Legal <legal@vendorco.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 14:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Leadership reporting redesign — proposal, HR questions, and comms draft

This looks reasonable. A couple of specific operational asks from my side:

- Please do not move any engineers who are owner-on-call for runtime-v2 launch until after the March 31 cutoff. We risk knowledge loss in the critical window.
- For the "pod" boundaries, let's gate by ownership (build vs. operate) and not strictly by component. I added inline notes in the Drive org-chart.
- Agree with Lauren: make the floating reliability lead an IC (L6) first; we can convert to manager later if needed.

I’ll prepare a short manager script for the readout to normalize messaging across teams.

Marcus
Head of Runtime
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: People Ops <peopleops@example-hr.com>, Legal <legal@vendorco.com>, Engineering Hiring Partner <eng-hire@talentbridge.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Leadership reporting redesign — proposal, HR questions, and comms draft

Thanks everyone for fast input. Short update and next steps: 

- Action items I completed: consolidated the impact summaries (see role-matrix-v1.3.xlsx), marked owners who must be excluded until after the runtime-v2 freeze (per Marcus), and converted the floating reliability lead to an L6 IC proposal.
- People Ops: table attached in Drive; please proceed with the scope reviews and advise on any comp actions.
- Legal: if you can review the comms language for title phrasing by Fri (Feb 20), that would be ideal.
- Communications plan: manager readout scheduled Mon Feb 23 at 10am PT; public announcement targeted for Tue Feb 24. Manager 1:1s to follow (2 weeks).

Attached: org-chart-v2.pdf (updated), role-matrix-v1.3.xlsx (updated), comms-draft-ops.md (updated manager script and FAQ).

I’ll post the final drive link to the Notion page once Legal signs off. If anyone needs early sight-lines to specific manager 1:1 notes, flag me and I’ll share a private doc.

Aditya
VP, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
